summary: A married couple shares honest thoughts about cultural differences, sharing chores, and funny everyday habits. They also look back warmly on how they first met and what made them fall in love.

phrases.quote: 你对我的第一印象是什么
phrases.usage: Use this when meeting new people or talking about what someone seemed like when you first met.
phrases.example: 新老师给我的第一印象很好。
phrases.example_pron: Xīn lǎoshī gěi wǒ de dì yī yìnxiàng hěn hǎo.
phrases.example_en: My first impression of the new teacher was great.

phrases.usage: Say this at the start of a new school term when everything is fresh and exciting.
phrases.example_pron: Gāng kāixué, zuòyè hái hěn shǎo.
phrases.example_en: School just started, so there's not much homework yet.

phrases.usage: Use this when something is bugging you or making you feel slightly frustrated.
phrases.example_pron: Zhè ge xiǎo chóngzi zhēn de hěn fán.
phrases.example_en: This little bug is really annoying.

phrases.usage: Say this when a warm, cozy place or a friendly group makes you feel right at home.
phrases.example_pron: Nǎinai jiā zǒng yǒu jiā de gǎnjué.
phrases.example_en: Grandma's house always feels like home.

phrases.usage: Use this everyday word when talking about saving or spending your own allowance.
phrases.example_pron: Wǒ bǎ línghuāqián cún qǐlái le.
phrases.example_en: I saved up my pocket money.

phrases.quote: 因为我一般肯定是不想吵
phrases.usage: A peaceful phrase you can use when you want to avoid fighting with siblings or friends.
phrases.example_pron: Wǒmen bié dǎ le, wǒ bù xiǎng chǎo.
phrases.example_en: Let's stop fighting, I don't want to argue.

phrases.quote: 两个人坐下来一起沟通
phrases.usage: A friendly invitation to tell someone to take a seat with you.
phrases.example_pron: Kuài zuò xiàlai kàn diànshì ba.
phrases.example_en: Come sit down and watch TV!

phrases.usage: Use this when your family rolls up their sleeves to tidy up the whole house.
phrases.example: 周末我们要全家大扫除。
phrases.example_en: We're doing a big family clean-up this weekend.

phrases.usage: Repeating the verb makes it gentle and friendly, like when asking someone to put away toys.
phrases.example: 快把你的玩具收拾收拾。
phrases.example_pron: Kuài bǎ nǐ de wánjù shōushi shōushi.
phrases.example_en: Hurry and tidy up your toys.

phrases.usage: A super common phrase for going outside, hanging out at the park, or having fun with buddies.
phrases.example: 今天天气好，我们出去玩！
phrases.example_pron: Jīntiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen chūqù wán!
phrases.example_en: The weather is great today, let's go out and play!

phrases.usage: Use this warm phrase when someone gives you a sweet surprise or says something really heartwarming.
phrases.example_pron: Tīng dào nǐ de huà, wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
phrases.example_en: Hearing your words, I am so touched.
